title: stocks and oil drop... ohh man
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: White House AI accord with self-policing and no new laws is a 'nothing burger' that keeps the AI buildout (and bubble) inflating; no laws slowing AI expected before 2029.
AI is at '10 p.m. in the party'; he sits at ~8.7 on his bull/bear scale and urges paying off debt ahead of an eventual bubble pop and recession.
With the 10y around 5.25% (5.29% intraday) he thinks yield pain is maxing out and peak yields are near, helped by dovish Fed Williams comments.
Williams' 'no need to rush' remarks cut odds of further hikes; he expects tomorrow's PCE to meet expectations and lower hike odds further.
Bonds and real estate are near a cycle bottom ('6 p.m. at the party').
Expects an Iran deal that would surprise skeptics and lift markets; oil slipping as Hormuz flows recover.
